title: Shop voice vendor order result
description: Structured result of an outbound call placing a restock order with a saved vendor. No payment or bank details.

vendor_order_completed.description: True when the vendor answered and the order was discussed.

available.description: True if the vendor can supply the items.

quoted_amount.description: Only set if the vendor stated a price. Never estimated.

eta_text.description: Delivery estimate as the vendor stated it, e.g. 'around 4pm today'.

vendor_notes.description: Optional free-text; must not contain payment or bank details.
